title: Defiant Mom Wrestles Cops After Teens Film Her Kids, Claims Racial Profiling!
description:
On March 29, 2023, officers in Ohio responded to an urgent call at the Embassy Suites Hotel, where they were required to assist with an eviction. The call involved a female suspect reportedly upset and yelling about somebody filming her kids. Despite hotel staff asking the suspect to leave the property, the suspect declined to leave, returning to her room, escalating the situation further. 

As the situation developed, the suspect and other guests exited the hotel's lobby, awaiting transportation. The suspect became argumentative with officers and hotel staff about the prior incident involving her children despite officers' warnings of potential arrest if the disruptive behavior persisted. The suspect refused to exit the hotel lobby or stop her disruptive behavior, leading to her arrest.

Officers handcuffed the suspect before placing her in the patrol car for transport to the police department. The female suspect was charged with disorderly conduct.
